name: wait-for-all-actions-test-ef2703e247/all-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: enumerated supported statements do not include fork statements or named worker declarations.
## Expressions: enumerated supported expressions/actions do not include worker send or receive actions.
### Other invocation restrictions: "map:keys" and "array:length" are supported method calls.
reason: The complete case requires named workers (waitTest17–20), fork statements (waitTest19–20), and worker message send/receive actions (waitTest20), none covered by the supported lists. Those are essential to asserted outputs, including w2="hello world" and w3=15, so the whole case is feature even though start/wait/trap, runtime:sleep and keys/length are listed as supported.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations and waiting on named workers in waitTest17–20.
fork statements in waitTest19 and waitTest20.
Worker send (a -> w2; b -> w1) and receive (<-w2; <-w1) actions in waitTest20.
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: ordinary future start/wait result mapping and panic trapping are combined with named workers, fork, and worker messaging in a single main.
Output markers exercise actual concurrent results and trapped panic behavior (waitTest16 expects 0), not just function signatures. No obvious malformed output markers; io:println is instrumentation.
